propositions: Native structured LLM replies with a single JSON object produce duplicate candidates in _candidate_dicts (once from _all_json_objects and once from json.loads(text)).

The identity check in _select_and_validate incorrectly flags semantically equal Pydantic instances as ambiguous because separately constructed objects fail is-identity comparison despite value equality.
Parser-generated duplicates cause false multiple-candidate warnings with identical first and last validated models, blocking normal gate behavior despite semantic validity.
Deduplication of semantically equal candidate dicts before validation must preserve discovery order and retain last-valid-wins behavior for genuinely distinct candidates.
Single exact-object replies must yield one semantic candidate and emit no ambiguity warning after dedup fix.
